rule_quote: NBA teams must report information concerning player injuries, illnesses, other medical conditions, or rest for all NBA games. By 5 p.m. local time the day before a game (other than the second day of a back-to-back), teams must designate a participation status and identify a specific injury, illness, other medical condition, or other reason for any player whose participation in the game may be affected for any reason.
